title: Matrix Determinant
seoDescription: Compute the determinant of a square NumPy matrix as a scalar measure of invertibility and volume scaling.
description:
Compute the determinant of an n x n square matrix to quantify volume scaling and linear invertibility.

$$
\det(A) = \sum_{\sigma \in S_n} \operatorname{sgn}(\sigma) \prod_{i=1}^n A_{i, \sigma(i)}
$$

Given input parameters `matrix`, return scalar float representing the determinant.

import numpy as np

def la_matrix_determinant(matrix: list) -> float:
